tests.reason: New Stage 5 installed-artifact coverage: one isolated bin/t3-plugins setup of the whole catalog (own HOME, XDG roots, prefix, agents root and two provider skill roots). Reads only installed bytes: adapter-to-entry routing for every operation, worker bundles, shared coordination contract, pinned digests, agents list/show, doctor, and owned uninstall that keeps overrides, config and user files. Hosts the Sandbox helper shared by the other Stage 5 modules.

New Stage 5 cross-stage regressions through installed CLIs and real pinned validators: a five-stage ape job restarted mid-way and resumed from the overview (plan, coverage, decisions and handles intact; no worker output in the overview); a stage-3 source regression rejected by the integrated final gate, then repaired within its own stage budgets; initial plus three repairs with the fifth pass and the fifth final pass refused across resume and owner-approved escalation; an imps job's babysitter pin stable across an independent current-pointer change.

New Stage 5 legacy migration coverage: imps major-version-2 runs keep status/validate/report/cancel through the rebuilt package while major-version-1 runs get the previous-package route; a legacy thinking topic resolves without promotion; an older package without bundles keeps legacy operations but cannot create or resume new-format jobs, which supply their pinned path; installs, upgrades and rollbacks never create acceptance.
